description: HP-79 serves as the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Sangrah sub-division in the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh. Managed by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, this office handles the registration of private motor vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses for the local administrative area.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Sangrah, District Sirmaur, Himachal Pradesh
